newsitem.title: USA: Fotoball USA sees improved profits in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Fotoball USA sees improved profits in Q4.

text.p: Fotoball USA said it expects improved sales and operating profits in its fourth quarter ending December 31 due to a $6.0 million backlog of toy car orders and an increase in baseball-related sports products.

Fotoball, a maker of sports and brand-related consumer products, reported a net profit of nil per share on sales of $3.0 million in its third quarter versus a profit of $0.14 a share on sales of just under $3.6 million one year ago.
The company said third quarter profits were hampered by sales of lower margin products. It expects fourth quarter margins also will be lower, but will rebound in 1997.
It attributed the lower margins to special order sales of toy cars for a Chevron Corp promotion. Toy car sales in 1997 will make up only a nominal portion of sales, it said.
Fotoball said it lost a competitive bid to supply toy cars for Chevron in 1997.
